keys.swarm.aura_ricochet_shots_desc: Shots bounce off the edges of the screen like pinballs, hitting what they cross.
keys.swarm.aura_ricochet_shots_ten: Pinball: four shots keep bouncing for the rest of the run.
keys.swarm.aura_rain_of_arrows_desc: Arrows rain down in a ring around you, hitting what comes close.
keys.swarm.aura_rain_of_arrows_ten: Arrowstorm: rain over the whole screen.
